title: Santa Clarita Training Exercise
description: Fictional bases, abstract demand cells and simulated travel times for a personnel-allocation exercise. No base represents a real station.
evidence_note: Real MODIS, VIIRS and EMIT observations provide separate historical context. They are not used to generate the simulated expected incidents or travel times.
limitations: This exercise is not a trained incident model. Coverage counts each reachable demand cell once; crew capacity, road conditions, actual response times and dispatch authority are not modeled.
